dedupe_keys.name: cosim toolbox cst for helics co simulation

description: CoSim Toolbox (CST) is a suite of Docker-based tools and libraries that makes it easier to build, run and analyse co-simulations with HELICS, the US Department of Energy co-simulation framework that lets simulators from different domains exchange data at run time. Version 1.0.1 was published on Zenodo in February 2026 by Trevor Hardy, Mitch Pelton, Nathan Gray, Fred Rutz and Wen Bo, with copyright held by Battelle Memorial Institute, which operates Pacific Northwest National Laboratory. CST provides Docker images so HELICS co-simulations run on Linux, macOS and Windows, a configurable logger that stores user-selected time series in a database, a central database and data model for federate configuration, APIs to read and write both without a query language, and a Python federate class that simplifies writing new HELICS federates. Coverage is not tied to a place. The source is downloadable from Zenodo under the BSD 3-clause clear licence at no cost, with documentation in the archive. Caveats: Docker is needed for the full toolset, and the source is distributed as a Zenodo archive. Simulation uses are power system co-simulation of transmission, distribution, markets and communications, and building digital twin testbeds. Related records: platform-helics is the underlying co-simulation framework, and platform-tesp is another PNNL co-simulation platform.
